scope: Approved 90-second playable core pilot. Original three-level game retained at /research.
loop: 80 budget; up to two preventive measures before rain at 40s; one monitoring choice from 10s; one rescue after 40s; automatic outcome at 90s.
goal: Power, water and seagrass each at least 45 at the deadline. Two viable strategies: runoff barrier + backup batteries; grid reinforcement + sediment control.
policyMeaning: Measures protect different outcomes; inappropriate dredging/planting damages habitat; delivery takes time; adaptation and visible plants are not verified carbon reductions.
newsBoundary: 2025-07-24 blue-carbon methodology review informs the educational context; the storm scenario and indices are fictional.
data: Separate local-storage namespace and version, automatic action records, downloadable JSON, three provisional binary behavioral rubrics. No pre/post or cloud-write claim. Incomplete measures null; reaction time not scored.
verification: Four deterministic tests cover winning alternatives, harmful actions, budget and phase gates, duplicate prevention, deadline and reload. Browser tested a complete winning run and 390x667 ending without scrolling.
